author: TeIq
content: Delivered: typed AppConfig + DbConfig + HttpConfig (serde-derived, env-driven via AppConfig::from_env). Db handle wraps PgPool directly. db::connect runs sqlx::migrate!() on success, fail-closed. /healthz endpoint returns 200/503 JSON based on Db::ping. Hash-chained polaris-schema-version sentinel migration. .sqlx/ offline cache directory primed with .gitkeep + documentation for #13's first sqlx::query!. testcontainers-backed integration test in tests/db_smoke.rs (skips gracefully without Docker). .env.example documents DATABASE_URL + POLARIS_HTTP_BIND. Zero unwrap, zero string SQL, zero Arc<PgPool>, zero anyhow in library surface, zero unsafe.
